references.title: Post-training a 4B retail agent with hard-token trajectory SFT

methodology.notes: Single PydanticAI agent in a ReAct loop with the standard Tau retail tools and a modified general policy-grounded instruction suffix. DeepSeek V4 Flash served as agent, user simulator, and natural-language assertion judge. All 114 base tasks ran for four trials with no omissions. Cost is the measured average agent API cost per trajectory; simulator and judge cost are excluded from the leaderboard cost field.

verification.details: The agent system prompt adds a general deliberation suffix; the user simulator follows Tau's task instructions through a custom first-party DeepSeek route.
